text:
maya: FYI nightly eval flagged a new class of failures after the q8 bring-up. ~12% of nightly tool/function calls are failing JSON parse in the fncall consumer. sample error in logs below.

jorge: can you paste the raw payload we got?

maya: here's one from the failing run (sanitized run_id):
```
{
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "format_report",
    "args": "{\"report\": \"ok\\u0000\\u0001binary\\u0000\", \"run_id\": 98765}"
  }
}
```

maya: consumer error: JSONDecodeError: Invalid \uXXXX escape at position 28 (while parsing args as JSON)

eva: interesting — args field is a string containing embedded NUL/ctrl bytes. looks like the model emitted non-printable token markers that got encoded into the string.

noah: any chance this is coming from our quant pipeline postprocessing? iirc we added a binary marker to indicate compressed blobs for caching.

maya: we suspected that. the failing set is mostly from the q8-quant variant on the new model. runs for fp16 baseline are clean.

infra-bot: [alert] nightly-eval-fncall-errors spike: 12% -> created incident ticket INF-5721.

jorge: repro steps? can we force a small prompt and replicate locally?

maya: repro script attached in the run artifact. quick repro: call the model with the prompt set 'report-gen-compact' and inspect function call args in the trace, e.g.
```bash
python tools/repro_fncall.py --model rwd-new-q8 --prompt-set report-gen-compact --run 98765
```

noah: i'll run it. if it's our postprocessing adding a binary marker, we need to stop stamping those into user-visible strings. immediate fix: sanitize args before serializing into tool_call.

eva: worth noting: consumers downstream expect args to be strict JSON objects (not strings) so we either must ensure model emits object or we parse-and-validate before handing off.

maya: stack trace from fncall consumer at the time: 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/consumers/fncall_handler.py", line 214, in handle
    args_obj = json.loads(message['tool_call']['args'])
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
    return _default_decoder.decode(s)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.9/json/decoder.py", line 337, in decode
    obj, end = self.raw_decode(s, idx=_w(s, 0).end())
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Invalid \uXXXX escape at position 28
```

eva: hypothesis: tokenizer->generation inserted control tokens that our encoder didn't drop, and some char escapes turned into invalid sequences when double-quoted inside args string.

noah: temporary mitigation: patch consumer to try a safe fallback: if json.loads fails, do a sanitize step that removes non-printable bytes and retries. will push a hotfix to staging now.

maya: can you also gate nightly on model variant? suggest disabling q8 variant until we confirm.

noah: will do. disabling q8 in nightly matrix now.

jorge: long term, we should add a schema check in the serving layer and reject submissions that don't match the function schema (args must be a JSON object, not a blob string). also add unit test in quant pipeline to ensure no control chars in system/prompts.

eva: I'll open an eval regression ticket with examples and mark as P1 for onboarding. includes sample payloads and repro.

maya: thanks. action items: noah add sanitize + hotfix, noah turn off q8 in nightly, eva open regression ticket with artifacts, jorge add schema gate in serving. I'll run a targeted rerun once hotfix is in staging.

nightly-bot: rerun requested by maya: queued rwd-new-q8-targeted (depends on hotfix).

noah: hotfix PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/consumers/pull/1423 — includes sanitize attempt and log tagging for future failures. please review quick.

eva: adding regression test harness to the model onboarding checklist so new quant variants run a fncall smoke test.

maya: folks, thanks — this explains the spike and gives a clear path. we'll keep the incident open until the nightly re-run is green and consumer logs show <1% fncall parse failures. :white_check_mark:
